profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange as 0800. Its SEC central index key is 0001867729. On its own site the company describes itself as a commercial-stage global developer of autonomous driving technology spanning Level 2 to Level 4, and says its business footprint covers more than 60 cities across 13 countries.

The company points to the WeRide One universal autonomous driving technology platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and what it calls an industry-leading accumulation of real-world operational data. It says it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi, and describes itself as a pioneer in large-scale commercial deployment of autonomous driving. It also states that it has been recognized on Fortune's 2025 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists.

No litigation, MCP servers, or tracked product entries are recorded for the company.
